record.label: Blocked exact-propagation theorems as subproblems
record.summary: The P2R0F3B family's three named blockers become attackable subproblems per the recursive protocol: the common-base remainder theorem, the fused 3D action certificate, and the carrier-independent covariance-remainder theorem. Each gets a Gate-0 statement of what it would buy (via the B-family receipts) before any derivation spend.
record.terminal_criterion: Each theorem either derived (reopening its B-family consumer with a priced construction) or reduced to a precise mathematical obstruction statement.
